title: Profiling
explain: Profiling shows where your program actually spends its time, so you fix the slow part and not a guess. Write a benchmark with `BenchmarkXxx(b *testing.B)`, run it with `go test -bench . -cpuprofile cpu.out`, then open the result with `go tool pprof`. Measure before and after every change.
exercise: Benchmark a recursive and an iterative Fibonacci, then compare the timings.
tip: Don't optimize by guessing. Profile first, because the slow part is rarely where you expect.
